CHROMIUM: drm/img-rogue: Don't fail probe if no cpu_thermal found The cpu_thermal node is used to find a temperature sensor for use during devfreq cooling. If the node is not found, this shouldn't be fatal - it just means that the driver can't cool itself properly. So, don't fail probe, just warn and keep going. This is useful in early board bring-up, where the GPU driver is ready before cpufreq and cpu cooling. Signed-off-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> BUG=chrome-os-partner:60805 TEST=build chromeos-4.4 for rowan and boot to UI Change-Id: I2b8cce3d69fce276aa2248dda26728734ae72da1 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/444471 Commit-Ready: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Tested-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: drm/img-rogue: fix NULL pointer derefence when adding shared fence The following kernel oops was seen when trying to add a shared fence to a reservation object: Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at virtual address 00000010 pgd = ffffffc037898000 [00000010] *pgd=0000000000000000, *pud=0000000000000000 Internal error: Oops: 96000005 [#1] PREEMPT SMP ... CPU: 0 PID: 3878 Comm: surfaceflinger Not tainted 3.18.0 #19 Hardware name: Mediatek Oak rev5 board (DT) task: ffffffc0751db100 ti: ffffffc05efc0000 task.ti: ffffffc05efc0000 PC is at reservation_object_add_shared_fence+0x30/0x33c LR is at pvr_buffer_sync_append_finish+0xf8/0x170 ... [<ffffffc0005fc35c>] reservation_object_add_shared_fence+0x30/0x33c [<ffffffc0005637a8>] pvr_buffer_sync_append_finish+0xf4/0x170 [<ffffffc00059e090>] PVRSRVRGXKickTA3DKM+0xb50/0xc30 [<ffffffc00055be80>] PVRSRVBridgeRGXKickTA3D+0x14d0/0x18d0 [<ffffffc00057e9b8>] BridgedDispatchKM+0x4c0/0x744 [<ffffffc0005a9b70>] PVRSRV_BridgeDispatchKM+0x150/0x194 [<ffffffc000528e44>] drm_ioctl+0x388/0x444 [<ffffffc000563c48>] pvr_compat_ioctl+0x40/0x50 [<ffffffc00038b01c>] compat_SyS_ioctl+0x130/0x14d0 Code: f9403283 f900329f f9402e95 b5000c43 (b94012a1) ---[ end trace 2e767e5f1d2c7357 ]--- This was happening because when reserving shared fence space it was using the deduplicated set of pmrs but the original set of pmr flags. This could then result in a shared fence being added to a pmr reservation object that didn't have any space reserved. BUG=chrome-os-partner:60851 TEST=Run Android CTS display test cases using 1.7 img-ddk, e.g. `cts-tradefed run cts --disable-reboot --skip-media-download \ --package android.display` Change-Id: I94864fb4b328cec0abf507bacf4ac9fe60560a63 Signed-off-by: Frank Binns <frank.binns@imgtec.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/418760 Commit-Ready: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Tested-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/424018 Commit-Ready: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Tested-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org>

eve: Modify 1.5 vs 3.0 current limit setting for P1B boards P1B adds 2 new GPIO signals to explicitly control the 1.5 vs 3.0 current limit selection. In addition, the use case for the 5V enable gpio changes to on/off and no longer needs to be toggled between input and output. This change is tied to the board version so that the operation for P1 and older boards is unaffected. BUG=chrome-os-partner:61431 BRANCH=none TEST=Manual Connected display adapter into C0 port and verified gpio signals: 1 USB_C0_5V_EN 0* USB_C1_5V_EN 1* EN_USB_C0_3A 0 EN_USB_C1_3A Then connect another adapter to C1: 1 USB_C0_5V_EN 1* USB_C1_5V_EN 0* EN_USB_C0_3A 0 EN_USB_C1_3A Remove adapter from C0: 0* USB_C0_5V_EN 1 USB_C1_5V_EN 0 EN_USB_C0_3A 1* EN_USB_C1_3A Also tested P1 system to verify that the correct board version is read and the signals match the expected value.
